## NU-AURA Production-Readiness Report

**Repo:** `/Users/fayaz.m/IdeaProjects/nulogic/nu-aura` · **Branch:** main · **HEAD:** 8fe7d79c
**Date:** 2026-06-17 · **Stack:** Next.js 16 / React 19 / Mantine (frontend) + Spring Boot 3.5.14 / Java 21 / PostgreSQL (backend)

---

### Executive Summary

The NU-AURA codebase is, at the code level, in strong production shape. Architecture is a cleanly enforced hexagonal/onion backend (184 controllers, 320 entities, layering respected not aspirational) and a coherent Next.js App Router frontend (285 routes). Authorization is mature: 358 fine-grained permissions enforced by 1750 `@RequiresPermission` annotations across 173/180 controllers, layered with PostgreSQL fail-closed RLS (RESTRICTIVE policies + FORCE RLS + boot-time bypass canary), with JWT-authoritative tenant resolution. Security has been hardened over many passes — nonce+strict-dynamic CSP, distributed rate limiting, JWT entropy/issuer/audience/JTI checks, DOMPurify on every rich-text render, zero string-concatenated SQL, no committed secrets. Builds are green on both tiers.

**However, the release verdict is NO-GO** because of a single, decisive, currently-live BLOCKER: the deployed environment runs with demo credentials enabled, exposing a public 1-request unauthenticated→SUPER_ADMIN login on the production host. The code gate for this is correct and fail-closed; the defect is a deploy-time env-var state, not a code bug. Per the program's scoring rules, any BLOCKER caps readiness at 60. Two confirmed HIGH/AMBER attendance timezone defects and a cluster of MEDIUM a11y/governance findings sit beneath that.

This is a **CONDITIONAL situation gated entirely on a config flip**: flip `DEMO_CREDENTIALS_ENABLED=false` + `NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE=false`, redeploy, and verify the demo path is dead — then the platform is realistically a CONDITIONAL-GO pending the attendance tz fixes for non-IN tenants.

### Confirmed Findings by Severity

#### BLOCKER (1)

- **Demo credentials enabled on live deploy → public 1-click SUPER_ADMIN.**
  Code gate is correct and fail-closed: `backend/src/main/resources/application-prod.yml:98` and `application.yml:119` default `demoCredentialsEnabled` to `false`; `db/migration/V295__neutralize_demo_admin_after_reseed.sql:28-43` neutralizes the Welcome@123 bcrypt digests (runs after the V291 re-seed); frontend `app/auth/login/page.tsx:42` (`IS_DEMO_MODE`), `:58` (SUPER_ADMIN `fayaz.m@nulogic.io`), `:124` (`DEMO_PASSWORD='Welcome@123'`), `:900` (panel gated). All deploy templates default OFF (`render.yaml:123`, `docker-compose.prod.yml:181`, `infra/deployment/kubernetes/configmap.yaml:95`). **The live Railway/Vercel deploy has both flags ON** (confirmed by prior 2026-06-17 live QA + MEMORY; live env not directly readable). Result: a 1-request unauthenticated→SUPER_ADMIN path on the public host. **Pure deploy-config flip; no code change.**

#### HIGH (1)

- **Live clock-in elapsed timer is timezone-skewed on page refresh.**
  `frontend/app/me/dashboard/page.tsx:82` sets `checkInTime = parseISO(dashboard.todayCheckInTime)`; backend `SelfServiceDashboardResponse.java:39` declares `todayCheckInTime` as offset-less `LocalDateTime`; `frontend/components/dashboard/TimeClockWidget.tsx:77` computes `Date.now() - checkInTime.getTime()`. HEAD commit 0b8b1501 fixed only the fresh-click path and added the L77 `Math.max(0)` clamp as a band-aid — the restore path re-introduces the skew. Fix: serialize check-in as `OffsetDateTime`/`Instant` (trailing Z) or return tenant zone id and construct the Date with that offset.

#### MEDIUM (8)

- **Two clock-in entry points record check-in time in different timezones.** `me/dashboard/page.tsx:96-99` sends no `checkInTime` → backend stamps tenant TZ (`AttendanceRecordService.java:92`), but `app/attendance/page.tsx:215-218` and `app/me/attendance/page.tsx:122-125` send `getLocalDateTimeString()` (client TZ). Standardize one source of truth.
- **Worked-hours duration wrong across DST.** `AttendanceRecordService.java:271-274` — explicit `TODO(DST)`: `Duration.between` on `LocalDateTime` ignores spring-forward/fall-back (±1h). Migrate columns to `TIMESTAMPTZ`, use `Instant`/`OffsetDateTime`. Gate go-live for non-IN tenants.
- **Negative clock-in duration — symptom clamped, root tz ambiguity only mitigated.** `TimeClockWidget.tsx:77` + `app/attendance/utils.ts:14` both clamp with `Math.max(0,...)`; underlying offset-less contract remains.
- **Stale UX readiness artifact overstates blockers.** `qa-reports/readiness-2026-06-17/frontend-ux.md:35-37` (UX-01 modals, UX-02 skip-link, UX-03 double AuthGuard) all contradicted by current code (SlidePanel role=dialog/aria-modal/focus-trap; `app/layout.tsx:84` skip-link to `#main-content` on `AppLayout.tsx:413`; inner AuthGuard removed `AppLayout.tsx:417-420`). Regenerate before any go/no-go use.
- **No jsx-a11y ESLint plugin.** Absent from `frontend/eslint.config.mjs` and `package.json` — a11y regressions uncaught despite strong custom design-rule lint.
- **~64 form files use `<label>` without `htmlFor`/`id`.** e.g. `app/biometric-devices/page.tsx:450,465,486,502,512`; `app/loans/new/page.tsx:195,216,235` (inconsistent — `:174`/`:256` correct). Screen-reader name resolution + label-click-to-focus broken.
- **`safeUrl` applied inconsistently to user-supplied hrefs.** `app/recruitment/candidates/[id]/page.tsx:389` (`resumeUrl`, no safeUrl import); `app/training/catalog/[id]/page.tsx:252,278` (`documentUrl` raw despite safeUrl imported at L37 and used at L163). A stored `javascript:` URL would execute on click.
- **God services / god components exceed repo 500-line rule.** Backend: `AuthService.java:1313`, `WorkflowService.java:1297`, `ExitManagementService.java:1016`, `ExpenseClaimService.java:979`. Frontend: 23 `page.tsx` >1000 LOC (peak `one-on-one/page.tsx:1771`). Maintainability/change-risk, not correctness.

#### LOW (selected)

- Edge proxy drops deep-link `returnUrl` for the no-cookie case (`proxy.ts:448,474`).
- `useCheckIn/useCheckOut` optimistic cache keys use UTC date fallback (`useAttendance.ts:185,194,241,248`).
- RSC 503 prefetch — **FIXED** (`prefetch={false}` on `LeaveBalanceWidget.tsx:105,160,170` + `me/dashboard/page.tsx:403,473`, commit 8fe7d79c).
- Frontend authz is client-side display-gating only (`proxy.ts:1-30`) — acceptable; backend is authoritative.
- Build: no Maven wrapper; inject HTTPS `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` in CI; add `outputFileTracingRoot`.

| Gate | Status | Evidence |
|------|--------|----------|
| Build passes (both tiers) | PASS | `mvn compile` exit 0 (3964 classes); `npm build` exit 0 (250/250 pages); `npm lint` exit 0, no `ignoreBuildErrors` |
| Login works | PASS | Password/Google/MFA login, mutexed refresh rotation, /auth/me-first restore, StrictMode-safe AuthGuard all verified |
| No unauthenticated privilege escalation | **FAIL** | Live deploy demo-creds path → public SUPER_ADMIN (BLOCKER) |
| RBAC enforced server-side | PASS | 1750 `@RequiresPermission` + PermissionHandlerInterceptor (pre-@Valid 403) + PermissionAspect defense-in-depth |
| Cross-tenant isolation | PASS | RESTRICTIVE RLS + FORCE RLS (V255), tx-local GUC, reset-on-checkout, RlsStartupProbe canary, JWT-authoritative tenant |
| No committed secrets | PASS | All git-tracked env files are `*.example`; k8s secrets.yaml is CHANGEME placeholder |
| Core data correctness | **CONDITIONAL** | Attendance worked-hours tz/DST defects affect non-IN tenants (1 HIGH + 2 MEDIUM) |

**Decision: NO-GO** — the privilege-escalation gate fails on the live host. The gate flips to PASS with a config-only change; once flipped and the attendance tz HIGH is addressed (or non-IN tenants are gated off), this becomes a CONDITIONAL-GO.

### Prioritized Remediation Backlog

**P0 — must fix before go-live (the blocker)**
1. Set `DEMO_CREDENTIALS_ENABLED=false` (or unset) in Railway backend env; redeploy so V270/V272/V295 neutralize the seeded SUPER_ADMIN.
2. Set `NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE=false` in Vercel frontend env; rebuild so `DemoLoginPanel`/`DEMO_ACCOUNTS` tree-shake out.
3. **Verify:** demo panel absent on `/auth/login`; `fayaz.m@nulogic.io / Welcome@123` no longer authenticates.

**P1 — fix before go-live for non-IN tenants (data correctness)**
4. Serialize check-in/out as `OffsetDateTime`/`Instant` (trailing Z); parse with offset on the client. Closes the HIGH restore-path skew and unifies the two clock-in entry points.
5. Migrate `check_in_time`/`check_out_time` to `TIMESTAMPTZ`; use `Instant`/`OffsetDateTime` for duration math (per the in-code `NUAURA-ATTENDANCE-DST` TODO). Until then, gate go-live to IN tenants only.

**P2 — fix this sprint (hardening + governance)**
6. Wrap `candidate.resumeUrl` and `content.documentUrl` (`:252`, `:278`) with `safeUrl()`.
7. Add `eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y` (recommended ruleset) — systemic fix preventing label/a11y regressions.
8. Add `htmlFor`/`id` to the ~64 unlabeled form files (RHF register name as natural id).
9. Regenerate `frontend-ux.md` against HEAD before using it for any release decision.

**P3 — post-launch (maintainability)**
10. Decompose `AuthService`/`WorkflowService` and the 23 >1000-LOC frontend pages (container/presentational split).
11. Append `?returnUrl=` to `proxy.ts:448,474` login redirects (reuse `sanitizeReturnUrl`).
12. Replace UTC date fallbacks in `useAttendance.ts` with `getLocalDateString()`.
13. Build hygiene: commit Maven wrapper, inject HTTPS API URL in CI, set `outputFileTracingRoot`, add a `tsc --noEmit` typecheck script.
